name: resource-booking-scheduling-platform
description: A generic resource booking & scheduling platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:push: cd backend && npx prisma db push
scripts.db:reset: cd backend && npx prisma migrate reset
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules backend/node_modules frontend/node_modules backend/dist frontend/.next
